convert_dict_to_namedtuple: convert a dictionary into a namedtuple so values are accessible as dot-notation attributes
convert_dict_for_attribute_access: convert a dictionary to a GenericDict namedtuple to enable attribute-style key access
convert_dict_for_immutable_access: convert a dictionary into an immutable namedtuple for read-only attribute access
review_convert_function: review the convert function that transforms a dictionary into a namedtuple with keys as field names
test_convert_function: test the convert function by passing a sample dictionary and verifying attribute access works
